account.data.title: Privacy and data
account.data.intro: This is what the shop keeps about you. You can download a copy or delete your account here.
account.data.keeps.account: Your account: name, email, phone and sign-in details.
account.data.keeps.orders: Your orders: contact details, delivery addresses, items, amounts, payments and shipments.
account.data.keeps.mail: Copies of the mails the shop sent you about your account and orders.
account.data.keeps.session: Your sign-in sessions and your cart.
account.data.policy: How the shop uses this data is described in the
account.data.export.title: Download my data
account.data.export.intro: Get a copy of your data as one JSON file. Downloads are limited to a few a day.
account.data.export.done: The file {file} was downloaded to your device.
account.data.export.care: It holds personal data. Keep it somewhere safe and do not share it.

account.data.delete.title: Delete my account
account.data.delete.intro: Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be undone. Enter your password and type the word below to confirm.
account.data.delete.deletesAccount: Your account, with your name, email, phone, password and sign-in sessions.
account.data.delete.deletesMail: The stored copies of the mails sent to you.
account.data.delete.keeps: Your orders stay in the shop's records without your name, email, phone and address (only the country is kept). Order numbers, items, amounts, dates, payments and shipments are kept for the shop's accounts.
account.data.delete.limits: Data that was already passed on to the mail, delivery or payment services is not changed from here. Ask the shop about it.
account.data.delete.wordMismatch: The word does not match. Type it exactly as shown.
account.data.delete.limited: Too many attempts to delete the account.

account.data.blocked.payment_in_progress: A payment is still being processed.
account.data.blocked.refund_in_progress: A refund is still being processed.
account.data.blocked.active_shipment: A parcel is still on its way.
account.data.blocked.mail_sending: A message to you is being sent right now. Try again in a couple of minutes.
account.data.blocked.unknown: Something else is still in progress. Try again later or contact the shop.
